preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes numbered between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of decorations is exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in decorations)
preconditions.description: Each decoration label a_i is between 0 and n inclusive.
No decoration label appears more than once, except for 0 which can appear multiple times.

postconditions.description: The number of possible configurations is returned modulo 1000000007.
The return value is the number of valid configurations of the tree modulo 1000000007.
